summary: Driver enacts every post-setup task mutation only via the PTY (n/picker/prompt for creation; /advance|$advance to the real agent) and uses task-service REST solely for GET reads (write_token never writes); no mutating REST/MCP call, fixture, or seeded task exists, and the state-wait gates have no mutation fallback, so a green run is only reachable if real user inputs drove the transitions.
